plan.notes: B.S. Psychology, Department of Psychological Sciences, College of Letters, Arts and Sciences. SEMESTER SYSTEM — all credits are semester hours. Built from the official MSU Denver 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog degree planner for Psychology Major, B.S. (https://catalog.msudenver.edu/preview_degree_planner.php?catoid=48&poid=12025). Structure: General Studies 33cr (Written Communication 6, Oral Communication 3, Quantitative Literacy 3, Arts & Humanities 6, Historical 3, Natural & Physical Sciences 6, Social & Behavioral Sciences 6; Global Diversity fulfilled within GenEd), ESSJ 0cr additional (PSY 3030 Multicultural Psychology double-counts as a Psychology elective and the ESSJ requirement), Psychology Core 13cr (PSY 1001/2001/2310/3010/3011), Content Areas 12cr (one course each in Social, Cognitive & Biological, Clinical/Counseling, Developmental), Psychology Electives 15cr, Senior Experience 3cr (PSY 4320 Advanced Psychological Research Methods; alternatives PSY 4330/4510/4650), Unrestricted Electives 44cr. Note: catalog text states '42 hours required for the Psychology major' but the listed components (Core 13 + Content 12 + Electives 15 + Senior Experience 3) sum to 43; this plan follows the component requirements. D- or better required in each major course; 2.00 major and overall GPA required; minimum 15 semester hours of upper-division PSY coursework. 120 semester credits total.
